acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Flame Elementals family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Conflagration Sovereign, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Temperature-Cycle Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Blue-white chest star, whole-body solar corona, standing flame crown, and a source-native scorched ground ring.

Signature mechanic: Arena Transformation — Three Temperatures: the chest star shifts the scorched ring through Cinder Drift, Twin Jet, and Fissure Mantle phases; completing each learned response extinguishes one segment of the solar corona and lowers the standing flame crown.
battlefieldDuty: Transform the arena through dull, white-hot, and blue-white phases that recombine every lower-form heat lesson.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no obsidian shell, no molten rock, no star, no corona, and no crown; T4 alone gains source-supported obsidian shell and molten rock; T5 alone gains its star, corona, and crown.
Pressurized water jackets, coherent steam loops, wet reflective valve collars, visible condensation return, and exposed drainage cores sustain rather than extinguish the native body.
counterplay: Resolve the announced lower-form pattern, then strike the dimmed star edge; each success permanently removes one corona segment and shortens the final cycle. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no obsidian shell, no molten rock, no star, no corona, and no crown, so pressure loss opens a jacket valve; T4 obsidian shell and molten rock expose a quench fissure; T5 star, corona, and crown contract when the return loop drains.
forbiddenTreatments: Water that erases native living fire
identityInvariants: A roughly humanoid upper silhouette dissolves into flame above and tapers or hovers below with no feet.
Temperature remains legible from dull orange through yellow-white to blue-white edges.
Open flame, ember, smoke, and later source-supported obsidian and molten rock stay materially distinct.
Core definition and directed combustion progress from a flicker to a sovereign star while heat remains readable rather than overexposed.
telegraph: The blue-white star changes edge color, the corona divides into the selected pattern, and one crown tine bends toward the active lower form.
